title: Assertion failure in typecore.ml on a binding operator declared with external
summary: `external ( let& ) : 'a -> ('a -> 'b) -> 'b = "%revapply"` and then `let& y = x + 1 in y * 2` stop the compiler with an assertion failure. OCaml 5.4.0 compiles it.

actual.text: The compiler stops with `Fatal error: exception File "typing/typecore.ml", ...: Assertion failed`, exit status 2.

cause: `typing/typecore.ml`, `type_binding_op_ident`: `assert (kind = Id_value)`, under a comment that asks whether `external (let+)` is valid.
